title: TAZ OS Policy
description: Declarative, versioned rule evaluated by the Policy Engine before any action executes. Covers security, financial, legal, commercial, engineering, privacy, AI-safety, compliance, operations, executive. See Volume 8.

rule.description: Declarative condition. Implemented by runtime policy engine.

if.description: Condition attributes (ABAC): identity, role, resource_type, resource_classification, action, value_threshold, risk_score, workflow_state, classification.

approval_owner.description: Identity ID required to approve when action=require_approval
